svg.text: ctlb: in the port list for uniformity, not connected
vss: body tie only; vdd: in the port list, not connected
SW_S2 - S2 vref -> bot (bottom plate), single NMOS; ctlb unused
Closed while the cell tracks: the bottom plate sits at vref = VDD/2. Its falling ctl edge IS the
sampling instant (bottom-plate sampling). It always opens at vref, so the charge it injects does not
depend on the signal; one NMOS gives one aperture edge.
a = driving side, b = plate side; ctl HIGH = closed, ctlb its complement (made in atop_cell).
S/D at the DRC-minimum contacted geometry (ad = W x 0.44 um, pd = 2 (W + 0.44 um)).
this drawing by sw_sch.py, checked by sw_schematic.sh. Ron while closed: analog_top sheet (op table).
